faq.heading: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subheading: Everything you need to know about our courses, vector illustration methodology, and community guidelines.
faq.q1: Are the courses suitable for absolute beginners?
faq.a1: Yes! Our vector illustration and book cover design modules start from the very basics of Adobe Illustrator and progress step-by-step to advanced industry standards.
faq.q2: How do I access the paid courses after enrollment?
faq.a2: Once enrolled, you can log into your student dashboard anytime using your account credentials. You will get instant access to structured video modules, resources, and live project files.
faq.q3: Can I request custom style replication or book cover design projects?
faq.a3: Absolutely! Apart from our learning academy, our professional studio team handles commercial book covers, spine layouts, and custom vector art direction. Reach out via the Contact page.
faq.q4: Do you provide community support or mentorship?
faq.a4: Yes, all enrolled learners gain exclusive access to our 24/7 artist community where instructors and peer creators review artworks and solve technical hurdles.
